$comment: Skills this machine's owner deleted on purpose, with the reason. Read by verify-all.ps1: a toolkit-owned file listed here is 'removed on purpose' instead of 'MISSING', and a skill listed here that reappears is reported as a revival with its token cost. This file exists because SETUP-NEW-MACHINE.md section 7 tells the operator to delete these after every reinstall, while section 10 tells them the audit must exit 0 - so without a declaration the documented procedure makes the documented success criterion impossible. Only a human edits this file. A skill belongs here only if the owner decided the capability is covered elsewhere; 'I could not find it' is not a reason.

toolkit_skills.name: advanced-event-mesh-lifecycle
toolkit_skills.reason: Not an ABAP capability. The AEM administrator agent is installed by the same toolkit and carries its own rules, so the skill costs ~200 chars in every request for a server this ABAP workspace never calls.

published_skills.name: lean-build
published_skills.reason: Duplicate of ponytail, which states the smallest-complete-change rule and the option ladder in one place.

published_skills.name: migration
published_skills.reason: Covered by migrate-custom-code, sap-migration-dossier and migrate-segw-to-rap, which carry the SAP-specific evidence rules the generic skill does not.

published_skills.name: safe-refactor
published_skills.reason: Nothing replaced it. ponytail's 'keep the structure the codebase already has' is a constraint, not a procedure, so a structural refactor has no procedure here - added to open items rather than covered by a claim.

published_skills.name: surgical-patch
published_skills.reason: Covered by ponytail's bug-fix rule (grep every caller, fix the root cause once in the shared code) plus the agent's Change intent table.

published_skills.name: verify-and-stop
published_skills.reason: Covered four times over: agent Evidence discipline, agent Report contract item 4, senior-abap-development section 5, and senior-abap-development section 6.

published_skills.name: tdd
published_skills.reason: Partially covered: the agent says 'use TDD for a feasible regression test' and generate-abap-unit-test writes tests, but the test-first ordering itself is stated nowhere. Recorded as a gap, not as covered.

published_skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
published_skills.reason: Covered by abap-debugging, abap-runtime-analysis and sap-st22-dump-analysis.

published_skills.name: code-review
published_skills.reason: Covered by ponytail-review; the deleted skill also ran parallel subagents, which fights the serial ABAP flow.
